title: Garage Squad
description: The Garage Squad teams up with two lifelong friends to get this 1955 Chevy delivery sedan back on the road delivering great memories.

title: Garage Squad
description: Tiffany had an '89 Camaro for 20 years, but blew it up during a burnout competition nine years ago; the all-female scooter gang joins the squad to get Tiffany and her car back on the road.

title: Garage Squad
description: The Garage Squad has never missed a reveal day, but this twin-turbo charged '72 Nova was one surprise problem after the next; it is seriously down to the wire on this one.

title: Garage Squad
description: This father-son project took a tragic turn to become a father-only project; the Garage Squad tackles this '70 Charger as a tribute car to the entire family.

title: Garage Squad
description: An eighth-generation member of the Studebaker family buys a 1959 Studebaker pickup on eBay; the Squad discovers it has been turned into the mechanical black sheep of the family.

title: Garage Squad
description: Good old American ingenuity is needed to repair a 1963 Porsche 356 that has been parked for years and lost its edge.

title: My Classic Car
description: Dennis travels to Nova Scotia for a British car show, then he'll head over to Utah and go for a spin in a Kurtis and an Allard.

title: Garage Squad
description: Having lost his gear-head father at a young age, a young man wants to finish what his dad couldn't; the '57 Gasser has been sitting for decades, but something else is also sitting next to it.

title: Two Guys Garage
description: Willie B and a dedicated team of friends come together to revive a group of donated vehicles for his annual Cars for Christmas charity event, helping provide reliable transportation to families in need.

title: Hot Rod Garage
description: Tony Angelo and Lucky Costa transform a beat-up 1974 Corvette into the 1969 wide body, four-speed they really want.

title: Hot Rod Garage
description: Tony and Lucky decide to build a boat of a car, a 1971 Cadillac Sedan DeVille, and drop it on airbags for a sweet-and-low cruiser.

title: Truck U
description: The newest debate when it comes to off-road: what is superior, a SXS or a full-size vehicle? We explore the reasons why one would want one over the other, while we do some upgrades to both along the way.

title: Truck U
description: The owner of these two trucks loves the GMC brand. We get his newest project, a 1946 pickup, moving with an LS swap, while the daily driver OBS GMC gets outfitted with a new A/C system, so his drives are a little more comfortable.

title: Build for Off-Road
description: Ian Johnson goes for the off-road ride, tackling everything from simple bolt-ons to full-on fabrication.

title: Garage Squad
description: Having been seriously injured, a mechanic's life was turned upside down, until the kindness of a stranger gave him hope; now these best buddies want to team up with the Garage Squad to tackle the rescue of a beloved '93 Chevy Dually.

title: Truck U
description: Today, we explore how to fit as big of a tire as possible under a Chevy 2500 AT4 with a small leveling kit. Matt and Bruno will discuss how wheel offset effects fender clearance, and how the right offset can set you up to run larger tires.

title: Roadkill
description: Old-fashioned, fun road trip in random, unreliable junk; David and Mike buy a 1966 Ford Econoline flat-face pickup, sight unseen, and hit the road.

title: Roadkill
description: Freiburger and Finnegan take a big-block 1980 Dodge Mirada on a road trip to the site of the Street Machine Nationals in Du Quoin, Ill.

title: Roadkill
description: Freiburger picks the adventure and Finnegan picks the vehicles, a survivalist VW Jetta and a horrible Toyota Sequoia.

title: Roadkill
description: Freiburger and Finnegan attempt to road-trip the Hemi Gremmie, but when they are foiled by engine trouble, they continue the road trip.

title: Roadkill
description: Freiburger and Finnegan buy an '86 Trans Am and take it for its first road test on the drag-and-drive event Sick Week; with a swapped 350 V8 and a six-speed, the big question is whether they be able to make it faster each day or even finish the race.

title: Roadkill
description: Finnegan and Freiburger attempt to get a bucket-list '66 Corvette -- abandoned halfway through an LS swap and restoration -- back on the road. With multiple iterations and attempts, the 'Vette hasn't been on the road for 30 years. Will they change that?

description: Finnegan and Newbern light the tires as they road test their LS-powered '66 C2 Corvette from Oakland to Las Vegas with the smokiest burnouts ever; explore along as they blaze the coast and hit the drag strip with Dulcich before breaking down in Sin City.

title: Roadkill
description: The guys attempt to check off the final five states Freiburger needs to hit all 50 by taking their junkyard T-37 across New England; the T-37 hits the road, and the road hits back before the guys leave their mark in New York City.

title: Roadkill
description: Finnegan and Newbern give new life to a '57 Chevy Bel Air that was pulled from a junkyard after more than 30 years. The guys drop in a small-block V8 and turbo 350 to get the car back on the pavement for a bumpy road trip back to where it came from.

title: Roadkill
description: Freiburger and Finnegan meet up with Derek Bieri to take a 1968 big-block Dart on a tire-smoking road trip, which includes a final run down Memphis International Raceway and some high-speed passes down George Ray's Wildcat Dragstrip.

title: Last Chance Garage
description: A Cherokee Chief, hoping to become a transport for some furry friends, looks to Tony to get things wagging; meanwhile, a Ford Torino owner looks to recoup his losses with the help of Tony's team.

title: Last Chance Garage
description: Tony's cherished dream car arrives at the workshop with the assistance of a friend; a farmer's grandson holds onto hope that his family's treasured heirloom can run again.

title: Garage Squad
description: Recent tinkering has an adverse effect on a 1969 Dodge Super Bee that was in storage for a couple of decades.

title: Motorhead Garage
description: If it goes, Dave Dobson and the Motorhead Garage crew are fans. They bring you their love for all things motorized as they modify cars, trucks, ATVs and motorcycles using aftermarket equipment, ranging from the tried-and-true to the innovative and new.

title: Roadkill
description: Finnegan and Newbern revive the '73 Chevy Ramp Truck to bring home the '55 Chevy Gasser known as Blasphemi. With a turbo 5.9L Cummins diesel now under the hood, they'll see whether the ramp truck will spin the tires.

title: Roadkill
description: After a devastating first road trip, on which the 426 hemi that's wedged into the 1975 AMC hurt itself, Finnegan uses a historied engine to overhaul the Gremmie; he surprises Freiburger at Roadkill Nights.

title: Roadkill
description: Previously, Finnegan surprised Freiburger with a 700hp hemi in his Gremlin; now see the lead-up to the surprise as Dulcich and Cotten keep Freiburger distracted with a road trip from St. Louis to Michigan in the Wreck Runner.

title: Build for Off-Road
description: Ian Johnson goes for the off-road ride, tackling everything from simple bolt-ons to full-on fabrication.

title: Build for Off-Road
description: Ian takes you through every step of the wiring process, from choosing the right harness and finding existing wires to tap into, to selecting the proper connectors for a clean, reliable installation.

title: Build for Off-Road
description: Ian tackles some of the design issues on his FJ45 project, making the necessary changes to get the build back on track. With a redesigned exhaust system and upgraded brakes, the FJ45 is ready to start moving forward again.

title: Build for Off-Road
description: Ian returns to one of his all-time favorite formulas -- a low center-of-gravity Jeep TJ built to conquer big terrain without a towering lift. He starts fabricating the custom roll cage and upgrading some things under the hood.

title: Overhaulin'
description: A woman's most cherished memories revolve around long drives with her father in his '69 Camaro; after he passes away, she keeps her family's passion for muscle cars alive by buying her own '15 Camaro.

title: Overhaulin'
description: A decorated 15-year Navy veteran felt unappreciated when she returned from overseas; her partner helped her buy a Mustang to show her how much she is valued.

title: Overhaulin'
description: A devoted father and off-road enthusiast always dreamed of having a perfect classic Land Cruiser; his wife enlists the help of Chip to give him the gift of a lifetime.

title: Overhaulin'
description: A cancer survivor treats his Challenger like a priceless relic, with a garage that's a shrine to Mopar.

title: Overhaulin'
description: A young rally-car fan works with his dad to get his WRX running, but no matter how hard they try, they can't get his Subaru purring; after several idle years, dad decides it's time to get his son into his dream rally ride.

title: Overhaulin'
description: A one-time heavy-metal singer trades life on the road for a life focused on family; over time, he scrapes together enough to buy a 2014 Corvette, and now his son wants him to stop settling and get the metal makeover his Stingray deserves.
